about_the_game:
Jackbox-style party chaos collides with classic tabletop fantasy in DungeonBox, a phone-controlled RPG for 3-8 players. Type your boldest actions, vote for the funniest idea, and watch a quick-witted Dungeon Master weave the winning move into an ever-branching adventure packed with dramatic dice rolls, treasure, and mischief.

Key Features

  • Fast party pacing, lasting campaigns – Every round feels like a mini game show, while choices carry forward through full quests.

  • Phone-as-controller – Join instantly via QR or room code; no extra mobile app required.

  • Vote-driven storytelling & dice – Shape the narrative together, then test fate with digital d20s and cheeky items like Gold Dice or Potions of Confusion.

  • Streamer-friendly – Audience voting and Remote Play Together support.

“Jackbox” is a trademark of Jackbox Games, Inc., and “Dungeons & Dragons” is a trademark of Wizards of the Coast, LLC. DungeonBox is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by either company.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: SteamOS 3 (Steam Deck) or Ubuntu 20.04 LTS 64-bit
  • Processor: 4-core CPU @ 2.4 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan-compatible GPU with 2 GB VRAM (NVIDIA GTX 660 / AMD HD 7850)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL-compatible

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 (Big Sur) 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (2014+) or Apple Silicon M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable GPU (Intel Iris Pro 6200 or better)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Core Audio-compatible

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-4100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 or NVIDIA GTX 650 / AMD HD 7750 (DX11)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
